verses.1: From the sea, it rises like clothes on the mountains; from the desert comes from a beautiful land.
verses.2: The difficult vision that was shown to me described those who lied and deceived others. Every time I cried, I felt like I was being punished for my actions.
verses.3: Therefore, my wounds were filled with blood. They held me like prisoners of birth. I was terrified when I heard the sounds. I was terrified by what I saw.
verses.4: May my heart be filled with fear at this moment, as I hear the cries of those who are in distress. This causes me great anxiety.
verses.5: The size of the altar was such that it could accommodate many people. The priests stood there, waiting for their turn to be called upon.
verses.6: For as my Lord said to me, “Go and stand there, waiting for him who will speak.”
verses.7: And he saw chariots of fire, horses, and men. He listened attentively.
verses.8: And the lion cried out from above the cliff: “O Lord, I stand always day and night. And I remain stationed there every night.”
verses.9: And behold, a chariot came out of Egypt, pulled by four horses. And the king said, “Fall, Babylon! Fall!” And all the gods of Babylon were destroyed.
verses.10: I, Muddathi and Ben-Garni, have heard from the Lord, the army of God, the God of Israel. I am telling you about this.
verses.11: May he who calls me from afar, from the night that keeps watch over everything, keep watch over everything.
verses.12: He said, “You shall keep it by yourself, both in the morning and at night. If you neglect it, it will return to its original state.”
verses.13: We set up our tents in the forest. We placed our tents there.
verses.14: In the time of drought, those who live on the land will be destroyed. They will be defeated in battle.
verses.15: Because of the destruction that came from wars, they were forced to flee from the destruction caused by enemy attacks, as well as from the obstacles along their path and from the hardships of war.
verses.16: For this is what my Lord said last year, during the second year of the lease. And all that was done was just a formality.
verses.17: And the rest of those who were among the rulers of the children of Kedar also abstained from eating, because Jehovah, the God of Israel, commanded it.
